facts: J. A. Wood designed the Moorish Revival complex, constructed between 1888 and 1891. It operated as the Tampa Bay Hotel over five floors.

record: Henry B. Plant Museum architectural self-tour
facts: There are six minarets, four cupolas and three domes. The main east entrance faces Plant Park. The west railroad entrance had curved verandas around its public rooms.
Keyhole arches, red brick, cast concrete trim, veranda wood tracery and crescent finials characterize the surviving building.
